title: WorkPulse performance.feedback_submitted v1
description: A nominated peer filed feedback on a draft performance review. Identifiers only — the feedback comment is peer PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

review_id.description: The review the feedback was filed on (UUIDv7 string).

employee_id.description: Employee the review evaluates — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).
